headline: Ramayana Day 22: ₹9.65 Cr India nett
lede: 7:00 IST: Ramayana Day 22: ₹9.65 Cr India nett
body:
## 7:00 IST — Last day

Through Day 23 the desk has Ramayana at ₹1,009.0 Cr India nett, ₹1,195.1 Cr India gross, ₹595.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,790.1 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹1,000.55 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, Yeh Prem Mol Liya at ₹4.00 Cr and Gunmaaster G9 at ₹3.65 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. NDTV is citing about ₹1,000.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹1,009.0 Cr India nett and ₹1,790.1 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.

editions.headline: Ramayana Day 22: ₹9.65 Cr India nett
editions.lede: Ramayana closed Day 22 on Friday, 27 November 2026 at ₹9.65 Cr India nett and ₹11.50 Cr India gross, +1.6% from Day 21's ₹9.50 Cr. That day played on 15,418 shows at 12.8% occupancy. This is the closed day on the desk, not a live estimate.
